description: This file defines a React component for displaying quiz details, along with loader and action functions for server-side data fetching and handling user interactions such as starting an attempt. It utilizes Remix framework conventions for routing, data loading, and form handling.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Defines the page metadata, specifically setting the document title.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches quiz information and user session data for the quiz detail page.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles starting a quiz attempt, including user authentication check and error handling.
